name: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Portable Fusion Battery PFB-2
product_name: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Portable Fusion Battery PFB-2
description: A backpack-sized fusion battery that provides 5 kW of continuous power output for 30 days from a single deuterium fuel cell. The PFB-2 is derived from micro-fusion reactor technology scaled down to portable form, providing enough power to run field equipment, charge weapons, power exoskeletons, or sustain a small base camp indefinitely. The battery produces no emissions and generates minimal heat, making it undetectable by thermal surveillance. Zheng-Dao developed it for extended field operations where resupply is impractical.
story_hooks: A PFB-2 was stolen and used to power an unauthorized manufacturing operation in a dead zone — the fusion battery provided enough energy to run a complete fabrication lab for months without connecting to any power grid.
A PFB-2 has been rigged as a fuel-air explosive — rupturing the deuterium containment near an ignition source would create an explosion equivalent to a small bomb.
related_entities: Ouroboros Energy Power Distribution Trunk Network

physical_description.visual_profile: Ruggedized backpack-style power unit with integrated carry frame. Cylindrical fusion core chamber at center, surrounded by modular cooling fins and power distribution manifolds. Clean industrial aesthetic with asymmetrical venting patterns suggesting internal reactor housing.
physical_description.dimensions: 45 cm height × 28 cm width × 18 cm depth; roughly equivalent to a hiking daypack
physical_description.weight_description: 8 kg total — substantial but wearable. Requires padded shoulder harness and lumbar support frame for extended carry
physical_description.primary_material: Aerospace-grade titanium-composite chassis with carbon-fiber reinforced polymer panels
physical_description.finish: Matte gunmetal gray with brushed metal accents; micro-textured non-slip grip surfaces on carry frame
physical_description.color_scheme: Dominantly gunmetal gray with accent highlights in electric cyan and oxidized copper (reactor containment ring)
physical_description.interface_elements: Three USB-C power outputs (top face), vehicle-mount connector panel (rear), digital readout screen (3.5-inch monochromatic green display showing fuel %), mechanical fuel cell ejection lever (side-mounted, tactile brass), status LED ring around core chamber (pulsing soft cyan during operation)
distinctive_features: Visible hexagonal cooling fins in matte black surrounding central cylindrical core
Soft bioluminescent cyan glow emanating from internal reactor chamber visible through reinforced transparent port
Modular fuel cell cartridge with quick-swap mechanism — handheld deuterium canister slightly larger than a thermos
Integrated cable management clips with color-coded retention points
Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries logo embossed on upper panel — red angular characters with Φ currency symbol watermark
Regulatory certification stamps: GLMZ Energy Commission, Deuterium Transport Authority, Zero-Emission Certification
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: ZHENG-DAO HEAVY INDUSTRIES / PFB-2 / SERIAL # [stamped in anodized copper] / Warning placard in Mandarin, English, Swahili
physical_description.condition_typical: Well-maintained units show patina on carry frame from sweat/oil; cooling fins collect minimal dust due to electromagnetic static field; fuel cell ejection lever shows micro-scratches from field swaps; green readout screen slightly yellowed from years of operation but readable
